candidates.title: Master User Configuration Rights

candidates.title: Technician Rights for Configuration and Operation
candidates.description: A DH Technician shall have rights beyond the DH General User, including being capable of setting up and making changes in the configuration of the system (e.g., setting system parameters and establishing user accounts) and starting and stopping operation of the DH System.

candidates.title: Prototype Development Duration Constraint
candidates.description: The “prototype” version of the DigitalHome System (as specified in this document) must be completed within twelve months of inception.

candidates.title: Development Process Specification
candidates.description: The development team will use the development process specified by DigitalHomeOwner Inc.

candidates.title: Use of Standard Technology and Tools
candidates.description: Where possible, the DigitalHome project will employ widely used, accepted, and available hardware and software technology and standards, both for product elements and for development tools.
ambiguities: Use of phrase 'where possible' introduces ambiguity regarding strict enforceability.

candidates.title: Cost Minimization and Final Report Reporting
candidates.description: The cost of DigitalHome elements (sensors, controllers, server, tools, etc.) for this project should be minimized. As part of the final project report, the development team will describe their efforts to minimize costs, including price comparisons between DH elements and comparable/competitive elements.

candidates.title: Simulated Environment Testing
candidates.description: The DH system will be tested in a simulated environment without an actual physical home and with all sensors and controllers simulated. The simulated environment will be realistic and adhere to the physical properties and constraints of an actual home and to real sensors and controllers.

candidates.title: Approval of Requirement Changes
candidates.description: Major changes to this document (e.g., changes in requirements) must be approved by the Director of the DigitalHomeOwner Division.

candidates.title: ISP Requirement
candidates.description: The home system shall require an Internet Service Provider (ISP).

candidates.title: Individual Home Web Server Capability
candidates.description: A DH System shall have the capability to establish an individual home web server hosted on a home computer.

candidates.title: Web Server Interaction and Control Capability
candidates.description: The home web server shall provide interaction with and control of the DH elements.

candidates.title: Web Server Plans and Data Storage
candidates.description: The home web server shall provide storage of DH plans and data.

candidates.title: Web Server User Accounts Management
candidates.description: The home web server shall provide the ability to establish and maintain DH User Accounts.

candidates.title: Web Server Backup Service
candidates.description: The home web server shall provide backup service for user account information, user plans, and a home database.

candidates.title: Gateway Communication and Broadband Connectivity
candidates.description: The DH Gateway device shall provide communication with all the DigitalHome devices and shall connect with a broadband Internet connection.

candidates.title: Gateway RF Module Wireless Communication
candidates.description: The Gateway shall contain an RF Module, which shall send and receive wireless communications between the Gateway and the other DigitalHome devices (sensors and controllers).

candidates.title: Gateway Indoor Transmission Range
candidates.description: The Gateway device shall operate up to a 1000-foot range for indoor transmission.

candidates.title: Digital Programmable Thermostats Temperature Regulation
candidates.description: The system shall include digital programmable thermostats, which shall be used to monitor and regulate the temperature of an enclosed space.

candidates.title: Thermostat Current Temperature Reading
candidates.description: The thermostat shall provide a reading of the current temperature in the space where the thermostat is located.

candidates.title: Thermostat Set Point Temperature Control
candidates.description: The controller part of the thermostat shall provide a “set point” temperature that is used to control the flow of heat energy (by switching heating or cooling devices on or off as needed) to achieve the set point temperature.

candidates.title: Thermostat Sensor Sensitivity Range
candidates.description: The sensor part of the thermostat has a sensitivity range between 14ºF and 104ºF (-10ºC and 40ºC).

candidates.title: Digital Programmable Humidistats Humidity Regulation
candidates.description: The system shall include digital programmable humidistats, which shall be used to monitor and regulate the humidity of an enclosed space.

candidates.title: Humidistat Current Humidity Reading
candidates.description: The humidistat shall provide a reading of the current humidity in the space where the humidistat is located.

candidates.title: Humidistat set point humidity control function
candidates.description: The humidistat shall provide a "set point" humidity that is used to control humidifiers and dehumidifiers to achieve the set point humidity.

candidates.title: Magnetic alarm contact switch entry monitoring
candidates.description: The system shall include magnetic alarm contact switches which shall be used to monitor entry through a door or window when the switch is active.

candidates.title: Security sound and light alarms activation
candidates.description: The system shall include security sound and light alarms, which can be activated when DigitalHome senses a security breach from a magnetic contact.

candidates.title: Appliance current state monitoring via programmable power switches
candidates.description: The system shall include digital programmable power switches which shall be used to monitor the current state of an appliance (e.g., a coffee maker is off or on).

candidates.title: Changing appliance state using power switch
candidates.description: The system shall be able to use a power switch to change the state of the appliance (e.g., from "off" to "on").

candidates.title: Remote control of home systems via web-ready devices
candidates.description: The DigitalHome System shall allow a web-ready computer, cell phone or PDA to control a home's temperature, humidity, lights, security, and the state of small appliances.

candidates.title: Communication center web server monitoring and control
candidates.description: The communication center of the DH system shall be a DH home web server, through which a user shall be able to monitor and control home devices and systems.

candidates.title: Gateway device broadband and wireless communication
candidates.description: Each DigitalHome shall contain a master control device (the DH Gateway Device) that connects to the home's broadband Internet connection, and uses wireless communication to send and receive communication between the DigitalHome system and the home devices and systems.

candidates.title: Environmental controllers and sensors equipment
candidates.description: The DigitalHome shall be equipped with various environmental controllers and sensors (temperature controller-sensors: thermostats, humidity controller-sensors: humidistats, contact sensors, security sound and light alarms, and power switches).

candidates.title: Reading and saving sensor values via wireless communication
candidates.description: Using wireless communication, sensor values can be read and saved in the home database.

candidates.title: Sending controller values to change environment
candidates.description: Controller values can be sent to controllers to change the DH environment.

candidates.title: Programmable thermostat remote control
candidates.description: The DigitalHome programmable thermostat shall allow a user to monitor and control a home's temperature from any location, using a web ready computer, cell phone, or PDA.

candidates.title: Reading temperature at thermostat position
candidates.description: A DH user shall be able to read the temperature at a thermostat position.

candidates.title: Setting thermostat temperature range and increments
candidates.description: A DH user shall be able to set the thermostat temperatures to between 60 ° F and 80 ° F, inclusive, at one degree increments.

candidates.title: Maximum number of thermostats per home
candidates.description: Up to eight thermostats shall be placed in rooms throughout the home.

candidates.title: Individual or collective thermostat control
candidates.description: The thermostats may be controlled individually or collectively, so that temperature can be controlled at different levels in different home spaces.

candidates.title: Single thermostat per enclosed space
candidates.description: A single thermostat shall be placed in an enclosed space (e.g., a room in the house) for which the air temperature is to be controlled.

candidates.title: Scheduling hourly thermostat settings
candidates.description: For each thermostat, up to twenty-four one hour settings per day for every day of the week can be scheduled.

candidates.title: Manual thermostat setting override duration
candidates.description: If a thermostat device allows a user to make a manual temperature setting, the setting shall remain in effect until the end of the planned or default time period, at which time the planned or default setting will be used for the next time period.

candidates.title: Thermostat wireless communication with master control unit
candidates.description: A thermostat unit shall communicate, through wireless signals, with the master control unit.

candidates.title: Support for Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values
candidates.description: The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.

candidates.title: Centralized HVAC system compatibility
candidates.description: The system shall be compatible with a centralized HVAC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) systems: gas, oil, electricity, solar, or a combination of two or more.

candidates.title: ASHRAE standard adherence
candidates.description: The system shall adhere to the standards, policies and procedures of the American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers [ASHRAE 2010].

candidates.title: Programmable humidistat remote control
candidates.description: The DigitalHome programmable humidistat shall allow a user to monitor and control a home's humidity from any location, using a web ready computer, cell phone, or PDA.

candidates.title: Reading humidity at humidistat position
candidates.description: A DH user shall be able to read the humidity at a humidistat position.

candidates.title: Setting humidistat humidity level range and increments
candidates.description: A DH user shall be able to set the humidity level for a humidistat, from 30% to 60%, inclusive a 1% increments.

candidates.title: Maximum number of humidistats per home
candidates.description: Up to eight humidistats shall be placed in rooms throughout the home.

candidates.title: Single humidistat per enclosed space
candidates.description: A single humidistat shall be placed in an enclosed space (e.g., a room in the house) for which the humidity is to be controlled.

candidates.title: Manual humidistat temperature setting duration
candidates.description: If a humdistat device allows a user to make a manual temperature setting, the setting shall remain in effect until the end of the planned or default time period, at which time the planned or default setting will be used for the next time period.
ambiguities: Text specifies 'manual temperature setting' for a humidistat device.

candidates.title: Humidistat hourly schedule capacity
candidates.description: For each humidistat, up to twenty-four one hour settings per day for every day of the week shall be capable of being scheduled.

candidates.title: Humidistat wireless communication
candidates.description: A DigitalHome system shall use wireless signals to communicate, through the master control unit, with the humidistats.

candidates.title: Door and window contact sensor capacity
candidates.description: A DigitalHome system shall be able to manage up to fifty door and window contact sensors.

candidates.title: Security alarm activation capability
candidates.description: A DigitalHome system shall be able to activate both light and sound alarms: one sound alarm and one light alarm subsystem, with multiple lights.

candidates.title: Security alarm activation upon security breach
candidates.description: When a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN, the alarm system shall be activated.

candidates.title: Small appliance and lighting management
candidates.description: The DigitalHome programmable Appliance Manager shall provide for management of a home's small appliances, including lighting units, by allowing a user to turn them on or off as desired.

candidates.title: Power switch management capacity
candidates.description: The Appliance Manager shall be able to manage up to one hundred 115 volt, 10 amp power switches.

candidates.title: Power switch state reporting
candidates.description: The system shall be able to provide information about the state of a power switch (OFF or ON), indicating whether an appliance connected to the power switch is OFF or ON.

candidates.title: Power switch state changing
candidates.description: The system shall be able to change the state of a power switch (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF), in turn changing the state of an appliance connected to the power switch.

candidates.title: Manual power switch override persistence
candidates.description: If a user changes the state of a power switch device manually, the device shall remain in that state until the end of the planned or default time period, at which time the planned or default setting will be used for the next time period.

candidates.title: Preset parameter directing capability
candidates.description: DigitalHome Planner shall provide a user with the capability to direct the system to set various preset home parameters (temperature, humidity, security contacts, and on/off appliance/light status) for certain time periods.

candidates.title: Monthly planner creation and modification
candidates.description: For a given month and year, a user shall be able to create or modify a month plan that specifies for each day, for up to four daily time periods, the environmental parameter settings (temperature, humidity, contact sensors and power switches).

candidates.title: Planned parameter value override
candidates.description: A user shall be able to override planned parameter values, through the DH website, or if available, through manual switches on household devices.

candidates.title: Historical monthly management report availability
candidates.description: For a given month and year, in the past two years, DigitalHome shall be able to provide a report on the management and control of the home.

candidates.title: Monthly report temperature and humidity metrics
candidates.description: The month report shall contain daily average, maximum (with time) and minimum (with time) values of temperature and humidity for each thermostat and humidistat, respectively.

candidates.title: Monthly report security breach logging
candidates.description: The month report shall provide the day and time for which any security breaches occurred, that is, when the security alarms were activated.

candidates.title: Monthly report system downtime logging
candidates.description: The month report shall provide a section that indicates the periods of time when the DH System was not in operation.

candidates.title: Environmental display update rate
candidates.description: Displays of environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, contact sensors and power switches) shall be updated at least every two seconds.

candidates.title: Sensor data acquisition rate
candidates.description: Sensor (temperature, humidity, contact sensor, power state) shall have a minimum data acquisition rate of 10 Hz.

candidates.title: Device communication distance limit
candidates.description: An environmental sensor or controller device shall have to be within 1000 feet of the master control device, in order to be in communication with the system.

candidates.title: System operational reliability failure rate
candidates.description: The DigitalHome System must be highly reliable with no more than 1 failure per 10,000 hours of operation.

candidates.title: Backup and recovery mechanisms incorporation
candidates.description: The Digital Home System shall incorporate backup and recovery mechanisms.

candidates.title: Daily system data backup schedule
candidates.description: The DH System will backup all system data (configuration, default parameter settings, planning, and usage data) on a daily basis, with the backup time set by the DH Technician at system set up.

candidates.title: System data recovery upon failure
candidates.description: If the DH System fails (due to power loss, loss of internet access, or other software or hardware failure), the system recovery mechanism shall restore system data (configuration, default parameter settings, planning, and usage data) from the most recent backup.

candidates.title: Account log in requirements

candidates.title: Development methods to support maintenance
candidates.description: The development of the DH system shall use methods and techniques such as documentation of requirements, design, and code; use of abstraction, information hiding, and module independence in system design; and use of IEEE standards [IEEE830, IEEE1008, IEEE1016, IEEE1028] and the HomeOwner Coding Standard [HO4710] to support system maintenance.

candidates.title: Prototype module design for commercial incorporation

candidates.title: System documentation format and archiving
candidates.description: All system documents (Software Requirements Specification, Architectural Design Specification, Module Detailed Design, Module Source Code, and all Test Plans) shall be up-to-date, use the Homeowner document format [HO2305] and reside in the HomeOwner Document Archive at completion of the project.

candidates.title: Approval process for development method exceptions
candidates.description: Exceptions to the designated object-oriented development (using UML 2.0) rule for HomeOwner products must be approved by the CIO.

candidates.title: Provision of online user documentation
candidates.description: The DigitalHome System shall provide users with online documentation about the DigitalHome system installed in their home, including an FAQ section, a section explaining parameter setting and sensor value reading (with limitations and constraints), and a section describing how to use the DH Planner.
